blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابن ماجه، باب الرياء والسمعة، رقم:٤٢٠٤
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Sa'id (RA) narrates, “The Prophet ﷺ came out (of his room) to us. At that time we were talking about Masih ad-Dajjal.” Rasulullah ﷺ asked, “Shall I tell you of something that should make you more afraid than Dajjal?” We said, “O Messenger of Allah, certainly tell us.” The Prophet ﷺ said, “It is hidden shirk (associating partners with Allah). (An example of it is) a person stands up to pray, and he beautifies his Salah because another man is watching him pray.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اُبَيِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ ﵁ قَالَ:قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ:بَشِّرْ هذِهِ اْلاُمَّةَ بِالسِّنَاءِ وَالرِّفْعَةِ وَالنَّصْرِ وَالتَّمْكِيْنِ فِي اْلاَرْضِ، وَمَنْ عَمِلَ مِنْهُمْ عَمَلَ اْلآخِرَةِ لِلدُّنْيَا لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ فِي اْلآخِرَةِ نَصِيْبٌ.
blocks.tamil_translation: “Give this Ummah the good news that it will receive honour, eminence, help and power to rule. (This reward will surely come to this Ummah in general. Then Allah will deal with each person according to his intention.) So whoever does the work of the Hereafter for worldly gain will have no share in the Hereafter,” the Prophet ﷺ said, narrates Hazrat Ubayy ibn Ka'b (RA).

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ شَدَّادِ بْنِ اَوْسٍ ﵁ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُوْلَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُوْلُ: مَنْ صَلَّي يُرَائِيْ فَقَدْ اَشْرَكَ، وَمَنْ صَامَ يُرَائِيْ فَقَدْ اَشْرَكَ، وَمَنْ تَصَدَّقَ يُرَائِيْ فَقَدْ اَشْرَكَ.
